name: Union City (United States)
description: Red field with a narrow vertical navy blue stripe enclosing a thin white stripe, charged with white maps of Indiana and Ohio side by side with a navy blue star on the state line.
history: Union City is a city in Randolph County, Indiana, on the Ohio state line opposite Union City, Ohio. The flag was adopted on 20 January 2021 by vote of the people of Union City; the red, white and blue represent the United States and the two maps the twin cities.

features.role: narrow vertical stripe of blue, white and blue for the state line
maps of Indiana and Ohio side by side
star at the position of the city on the state line
